_metadata.title: Public Sector Accounting & Oversight
_metadata.description: A sovereign public-sector cloud: two public service providers (State Cloud Services Centre, National HPC & AI Centre) serving ten agencies, municipalities and universities. Offerings are grouped by service layer, GPUs are metered per accelerator model, PaaS is billed per hour, and six quarters of usage and invoices end in the current month. Includes offering users in screening states and a governance user with read-only global access for oversight reporting.
scenarios: Quarterly oversight report: usage, cost and growth per agency and quarter
Metering per service layer (IaaS / PaaS / SaaS / HPC & AI category groups)
Metering per chip type (H100, A100, L40S, AMD MI250X GPU-hours)
Per-hour billing of managed Kubernetes and PostgreSQL plans
User demographics: nationality, organisation type, identity source, assurance
Screening end users of a GPU offering with a compliance checklist
Offering users pending additional validation or restricted by the provider
Resold partner GPU capacity screened by the reselling provider
Governance-body user with the global support role, no staff rights
White-labelled portal with anonymous catalogue browsing disabled

user_agreements.content:
# Public Sector Cloud - Terms of Use

Services are available to public bodies and their authorised staff and contractors. Access is personal; accounts are reviewed quarterly. Usage and cost data are reported to the Public Governance Body every quarter.

# Privacy Notice

We process identity attributes received from the national eID (TARA) or eduTEAMS to verify eligibility. Service providers receive only the attributes configured for each offering.

offerings.name: Government VM Cloud
offerings.description: Sovereign IaaS virtual machines hosted in two state data centres. Metered hourly by vCPU and RAM, invoiced monthly.

offerings.name: Sovereign Object Storage
offerings.description: S3-compatible object storage with data kept in-country.

offerings.name: Managed Kubernetes
offerings.description: CIS-hardened Kubernetes. The control plane is billed per hour it runs; worker capacity is metered in vCPU-hours.

offerings.name: Managed PostgreSQL
offerings.description: Managed PostgreSQL with point-in-time recovery. Billed per instance-hour.

offerings.name: Secure Document Collaboration
offerings.description: Document editing and sharing for classified-up-to-restricted material, licensed per seat per month.

offerings.name: National HPC Cluster
offerings.description: CPU partition of the national cluster. Usage reported every 30 minutes by waldur-site-agent from SLURM accounting, per account and per user.

offerings.name: AI Compute - NVIDIA H100
offerings.description: NVIDIA H100 SXM 80 GB nodes for model training. Metered in GPU-hours per accelerator model. Access requires the AI compute eligibility checklist.

offerings.name: AI Compute - NVIDIA A100
offerings.description: NVIDIA A100 80 GB nodes for training and fine-tuning. Metered in GPU-hours.

offerings.name: AI Inference - NVIDIA L40S
offerings.description: NVIDIA L40S nodes for inference services. Metered in GPU-hours.

offerings.name: Partner GPU - AMD MI250X (resold)
offerings.description: AMD MI250X capacity bought from a European partner supercomputer and resold to national agencies. End users are registered and screened by the National HPC & AI Centre before their accounts are requested upstream.
